subject: general
question: Congress Party observed 26th January 1930 as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Independence Day.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A** public declaration **was made on **26 January 1930 **– a day which the **Congress Party **urged **Indians **to **celebrate **as **Independence Day**.
 
• The **declaration **was **passed **due to the **breakdown of negotiations **between **leaders of the freedom movement **and the **British **over the question of **dominion status for India**.
 
• The **decade closed **with the **Congress resolving **to fight for **Purna Swaraj **(complete independence) **in 1929 **under the **presidentship **of **Jawaharlal Nehru**.
 
• Consequently, **“Independence Day” **was observed on **26th January 1930**, all over the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Indian National Congress**, colloquially the **Congress Party**, is a **political party **in India with widespread roots. **Founded in 1885**, it was the **first modern nationalist movement **to **emerge **in **the British Empire in Asia **and **Africa**.
 
• **Silent Protest Day **is on the **second Friday of April**.
 
• **Republic Day **is on the **26th of January**.
 
• **Bharat Diwas **is on the **15th of August**.
